name: litroot
description: A project-scoped local literature manager for paper-fetch Markdown.

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && pnpm run build:service && pnpm run check:bundle-syntax && pnpm run test:packaged-preload
scripts.check:bundle-syntax: node --check out/main/index.js && node --check out/preload/index.js && node --check dist/service/litroot-service.cjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:source
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:package-boundary
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:package-boundary
